business_problem: Thinla needed to scale a global influencer-marketing platform, keep API performance stable under large international campaign loads, and improve the precision of its creator-matching model without losing cost control.
solution_summary: Thinla deployed its influencer-marketing platform and Tide influencer AI model on Huawei Cloud to scale global campaigns while making creator matching more precise. CCE hosts the platform's microservices and absorbs up to 100,000 API calls per second, while WAF and traffic monitoring protect the public interfaces and trigger elastic scaling. ECS and LTS feed a real-time monitoring layer so campaign metrics and logs can be analyzed continuously and strategy changes can be made during live programs. Compute resources are centrally scheduled behind ELB to keep utilization and costs under control. On the AI layer, Ascend compute optimizes Thinla's self-developed Tide model for influencer retrieval, attribute recognition, and brand matching. Data from campaigns and creator interactions flows through the platform into model scoring and back to marketers as higher-precision creator recommendations.

data_flow: Campaign events, creator attributes, API traffic, and monitoring logs flow through the CCE-hosted platform into ECS/LTS monitoring and ELB-managed compute. Ascend-backed model scoring then identifies the best influencer matches and returns optimized recommendations and campaign insights to marketers.
